title: So When
description:
Phone call. Mom.
"Eating well? Sleeping okay?" A few exchanges — then it came.
"All your friends are getting married. When is it your turn?"

{name} held the phone slightly away from the ear.

choices.text: "I'll figure it out" — short and done.  (boundary / awkward aftermath)
choices.result_text:
"Okay, okay." Mom said.
A small guilt crept in after hanging up.

choices.text: "Something else needs to come first" — open up a little.  (honesty / worry caused)
choices.result_text:
Mom went quiet for a long moment.
Then: "I know it's hard. If there's anything Mom can do, just say."
Nearly cried on the walk home.

choices.text: "Actually there's someone nice" — buy some peace.  (temporary relief / lie burden)
choices.result_text:
Mom suddenly lit up. "What's this person like?"
{name} regretted it the moment the words came out.

title: News from a Sibling
description:
Sibling got a job.
Good company, good terms.
Parents overjoyed.

{name} was genuinely happy — about 70%.
The other 30%: shame at the comparison happening inside.

choices.text: Congratulate them sincerely.  (family bond / inner friction)
choices.result_text:
"That's amazing, really." Said it on the call.
Sibling said: "Sorry you should be the one settling in first."
That line was somehow warmer than anything else.

choices.text: Congratulate but create some distance.  (self-protection / relationship gap)
choices.result_text:
Sent a "Happy for you" and kept away for the day.
Waited for the feelings to settle before reconnecting.

title: Holiday Table
description:
Family gathering.
A cousin was showing photos of a new car. "Things have been going pretty well."
Aunt looked at {name}. "How are things with you lately?"

Everyone turned. Steam rose from the food.

choices.text: "Just getting by" — deflect.  (defense / self-deprecation)
choices.result_text:
"Good health is what matters." An uncle said.
Conversation moved on.
{name} ate more food.

choices.text: "Working hard — good news coming soon."  (declaration / self-imposed pressure)
choices.result_text:
Relatives smiled. "We're counting on it."
On the ride home, those words felt heavier.
Said out loud now. Has to be kept.

choices.text: Leave early. This table is hard today.  (escape / relationships)
choices.result_text:
"I'll head out first" and left.
Everyone looked disappointed, no one stopped {name}.
Finally breathing freely on the subway.

title: January 1st
description:
A new year.
{name} took out a notebook and started writing goals.
Halfway through — some of these were last year's goals too.

Crossed them out. Started again.

choices.text: Set ambitious goals. Nothing done is nothing done.  (high aim / failure risk)
choices.result_text:
The list was bold.
Might not all happen. Better to reach for ten and hit three than reach for nothing.

choices.text: Set realistic goals. Only what's achievable.  (realism / safe targets)
choices.result_text:
Three items. All doable.
This year's completion rate will probably be higher.

choices.text: Write nothing. The goal lives in my head.  (internalized / unrecorded)
choices.result_text:
Closed the notebook.
Writing never helped anyway — decided to just move.
This year: only action.

title: It Was Today
description:
Today was the birthday.
Mom sent a KakaoTalk message. A couple of others.
{name} bought a convenience store cake — one ₩600 candle pressed in.

Not a bad day. Just quiet.

choices.text: Celebrate alone. This is enough.  (self-acceptance / loneliness)
choices.result_text:
{name} ate the cake alone.
No candles blown, no singing — still here another year.
That was enough.

choices.text: Reach out to an old friend. Grab food.  (connection / initiative)
choices.result_text:
Friend said "Wait — today's your birthday?" and came right out.
Two people, BBQ, that was all.
Better than alone.

title: Blind Date
description:
A senior colleague set up a blind date (소개팅).
Sitting across the café table — first impression: not bad.
Jobs, hobbies, family — the usual circuit.

At some point {name} realized: not sure how to explain the current situation.

choices.text: Be honest. "I'm somewhere in the middle of it all."  (honesty / impression risk)
choices.result_text:
A short silence.
Then: "I had a period like that too."
The conversation went deeper.

choices.text: Package it. First impressions matter.  (strategic presentation / maintenance burden)
choices.result_text:
"Freelancing across a few projects" — not untrue.
But this version of things requires upkeep.

choices.text: The vibe's off. Wrap it up early.  (avoidance / closed door)
choices.result_text:
"Nice meeting you, I'll be in touch." Left.
No follow-up.

title: In the Feed
description:
A face in the 'People You May Know' section.
An ex.
Looking good. Travel photos, smiling photos.

{name} lingered on the profile, then closed it.

choices.text: Move on. Separate lives now.  (acceptance / introspection)
choices.result_text:
Looked away.
The face stayed around for a while anyway.

choices.text: Send a quick 'how are you.'  (courage / uncertainty)
choices.result_text:
Sent it.
Response came after a while: "Doing well. You?"
Not a long exchange. Fine though.

choices.text: Block. Clean break.  (decisiveness / closure)
choices.result_text:
{name} pressed block.
Lighter. A little sore — but forward-facing.

title: Year-End Tax Season
description:
Year-end tax settlement (연말정산) time.
Receipts, medical expenses, education, donations.
{name} stopped midway through the paperwork.
Looks like a refund is possible. How much — only submitting will tell.

choices.text: Go through it carefully. Good exercise too.  (tax savings / time)
choices.result_text:
Two days of paperwork. The refund came back bigger than expected.
"Would have just paid this without knowing." Tax is something those who study it win.

choices.text: Submit the basics only. Too much hassle.  (time saved / refund missed)
choices.result_text:
Done quickly.
Later learned a colleague got a bigger refund by being thorough.
Next year, more careful.

title: The Upstairs Neighbor
description:
1 a.m.
Thumping from upstairs. Third time tonight.
Can't concentrate. Can't sleep.

choices.text: Go knock on the door.  (direct resolution / confrontation risk)
choices.result_text:
Knocked. A man in his early thirties answered.
"Sorry, didn't realize." Quiet after that.
Uncomfortable conversation — but solved.

choices.text: Report to building management.  (indirect resolution / slow fix)
choices.result_text:
Management made an announcement.
Calmed down within days. No direct contact needed.

choices.text: Just endure it. Conflict isn't worth it.  (avoidance / sleep deprivation)
choices.result_text:
Put in earphones and forced sleep.
Woke up heavy.
Noise is a constant in Korean apartment living — learning to tune it out or not.

title: 2 a.m. Convenience Store
description:
2 a.m. convenience store.
Boiling cup ramen — someone else was eating alone at another table.
Neither of them spoke.
A little rain outside the window.

The quiet of the early morning shared with a stranger — not bad.

choices.text: Eat and leave. Comfortable silence.  (independence / peace)
choices.result_text:
Finished and walked out.
The rain had stopped.

choices.text: Say something. Felt like talking tonight.  (connection attempt / uncertain)
choices.result_text:
"Good ramen, right?" — eye contact for a second.
"Yeah. Best late-night option."
Short exchange. No names.
Warm anyway.

title: Old Diary
description:
It came up while packing.
A diary from five years ago.
What the {name} from back then was worried about. What they wanted.

Some of it overlapped with now. Some of it had changed.

choices.text: Read it all the way through.  (reflection / time)
choices.result_text:
Two hours in.
Laughed at some pages, paused at others.
That version of {name} doesn't need to worry about this one.

choices.text: Toss it. The past is past.  (clean break / release)
choices.result_text:
Put it in the recycling bag.
Lighter. Forward only.

title: Parents Coming Over
description:
Mom said she wanted to come up with some side dishes.
Three hours to clean the place.
Opened the windows.
Worried the room would look too small.

choices.text: Show it as it is.  (honesty / worry caused)
choices.result_text:
Mom walked around once and said nothing.
Unpacked the side dishes. "Are you eating properly?"
That was all. That was enough.

choices.text: Put on a brave face. Don't want them to worry.  (self-protection / distance)
choices.result_text:
"Doing well, it's fun." Said with conviction.
Mom seemed to believe it — or chose to.

title: Blackout
description:
Lights out, suddenly.
Flashlight on the phone.
Looked outside — whole block dark.

Deadline was tomorrow.

choices.text: Head to a café. Finish it there.  (solution / expense)
choices.result_text:
Grabbed the laptop and went.
Same café as others in the same situation.
One Americano, two hours — deadline met.

choices.text: Call it a forced rest day.  (acceptance / tomorrow's pressure)
choices.result_text:
Lay in the dark and looked at the phone.
Power came back an hour later.
Actually — needed the pause.

title: Heat Advisory
description:
38°C.
Subway was air-conditioned. Transfer corridors were saunas.
{name}'s room had no AC.
One fan. One bag of ice.

choices.text: Buy an AC unit. Health first.  (health / expense)
choices.result_text:
Got a secondhand unit installed.
Slept properly that night for the first time in weeks.
Electricity bill will go up. Worth it.

choices.text: Use public cooling centers.  (save / inconvenient)
choices.result_text:
Library, subway station, convenience store on rotation.
Less time at home.
Always slightly warm somewhere.

choices.text: Endure it. Autumn comes.  (frugal / health drain)
choices.result_text:
Made it through somehow.
Body felt worn out by the time autumn arrived.

title: Cold Snap
description:
Minus 15°C.
Gloves nowhere to be found.
The commute wind cut at the face.

Anywhere warm felt like a luxury.

choices.text: Get a hot soup somewhere. Take care of the body.  (self-care / expense)
choices.result_text:
A bowl of soondubu jjigae.
The heat going down was everything.
Worth every won.

choices.text: Get home early.  (save / warmth)
choices.result_text:
Went straight under the blanket.
Warm. That was enough.
